en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large, monumental building on a cobblestone square. The structure has a mix of neoclassical and early modernist features, multiple tiers with high windows, and an elaborate roof with small towers or spires. The ground floor contains shopfronts with signs visible in the windows, and a few pedestrians and horse‑drawn vehicles stand in front. The expansive foreground is an empty cobbled plaza or street, emphasizing the scale of the edifice.
